Kelly Oubre Jr. was back in Philly for the first time as a Pacer on Sunday, and appreciative of how his Sixers’ stint rejuvenated his NBA career. 

“When they talk about the City of Brotherly Love, I think they’re talking about your soul.”

media.title: Kelly Oubre Jr. thanks the Sixers for giving him ‘new life in my basketball career’
media.description: Oubre, who spent the previous three seasons with the Sixers, returned to Philly for the first time since signing with the Pacers this offseason. He finished Sunday with 16 points on 6-of-11 shooting.

items.title: “Love him,” Pacers head coach Rick Carlisle says of Kelly Oubre Jr. ahead of his return to Philadelphia. “Such an upbeat guy and he's such a unique person. Love the wardrobe.”
items.author: Adam Aaronson
items.body_excerpt:
“Love him,” Pacers head coach Rick Carlisle says of Kelly Oubre Jr. ahead of his return to Philadelphia. “Such an upbeat guy and he's such a unique person. Love the wardrobe.”

Praised Oubre’s recent defensive work and ability to score without plays being called for him.
